selection: All293 names, in order, of the existing frozen joint_a5_panel.json and pinned still_open.json. The original first16 negative results remain retained, not replaced.
motivation: Pinned external search/glsearch.py requires independent four-dimensional seed directions and det(seed pairing)!=0. Homogenized affine extensions of a3-dimensional action have all directions in a3-space and singular seed pairing, while they can still have zero global fixed space and certify rank4. This is a concrete missing search architecture, without challenging any of the243 valid deposited certificates.
test: Exhaust every GL3(F2) quotient kernel of each double-cover group using the verified13368 generating-triple Aut-orbits. Test binary natural, dual and Steinberg ordinary cocycles; when the deck is inner, test natural/dual rank-one meridian root lifts. Only full GL3 linear images are covered.
positive_control: T(4,7): first generating pair X,Y with orders4,7 and X^-1*Y^2 of order2. All translations satisfy the torus relation because both norm operators vanish. Impose meridian root admissibility, retain the4-dimensional space, a nonprincipal cocycle, homogeneous4x4 matrices, affine image enumeration and singular pairing. Derive the uniform known torus family T(4,7*(2r+1)), r>=0, separately from the finite check.
acceptance: Any apparent sharp hit requires independent matrix/kernel, four-seed upper and knot/source/known-family checks before a named closure is claimed. New coefficient group and positive control need independent projective PSL2(F7)/PGL2(F7) replay.
scope: All epimorphisms to this finite quotient; not every proper-image representation, field or finite group. External code inspection concerns search coverage, not validity of its certificates. No untested complex integrability or full MRC assertion.
